name: Sarah Johnson
text: The delivery was lightning fast and the food arrived piping hot! The butter chicken is absolutely divine — tastes just like homemade.

name: Michael Chen
text: I've been ordering from FlavorDash for months now. Their sushi selection is incredible and always fresh. Highly recommend the Dragon Roll!

name: Emma Williams
text: Love the healthy options! The Kale & Quinoa salad is my go-to post-workout meal. Great quality and perfect portions.

name: David Rodriguez
text: Exceptional variety and consistent quality. The pasta dishes are restaurant-grade. FlavorDash has raised the bar for food delivery.

name: Priya Sharma
text: As a chef, I'm picky about my food. FlavorDash never disappoints. The Biryani is aromatic and authentic — truly exceptional delivery service.

name: James Thompson
text: Perfect for my busy schedule. Ordering is super easy and the 30-minute delivery is a lifesaver. The app interface is slick too!
